ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactRef.jsons.description: ArtifactRef identifies an immutable artifact without granting read access.

artifactId.description: artifact_id is an opaque artifact identity.

contentDigest.description: content_digest binds the reference to immutable content.

tenantId.description: tenant_id scopes the artifact identity and prevents cross-tenant reuse.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactRef.jsons.title: Artifact Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CausalContext.jso.description: CausalContext binds messages to an ordered, fenced causal history.

causationId.description: causation_id names the immediate triggering event or command.

fence.description: fence prevents an expired lease holder from committing.

sequence.description: sequence is monotonically assigned by the canonical ledger.

traceId.description: trace_id identifies a separately authorized trace stream.

watermark.description: watermark records the complete source position observed by a projection.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CausalContext.jso.title: Causal Context

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Cursor.jsonschema.description: Cursor pins an ordered replay or status position without exposing storage internals.

token.description: token is an opaque bounded continuation token.

watermark.description: watermark is the inclusive canonical event watermark observed by the caller.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Cursor.jsonschema.title: Cursor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.By.description: bytes identifies a raw-byte half-open interval.
ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.By.title: Bytes Anchor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Co.description: CodeAnchor identifies an immutable Git tree and optional precise source range.

gitOid.description: git_oid identifies an immutable commit or tree.

range.description: range identifies the source span when available.

symbolId.description: symbol_id identifies a resolved code symbol when available.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Co.title: Code Anchor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Pa.description: PageAnchor identifies one document page and optional visual bounds.
ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Pa.title: Page Anchor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Ta.description: TableAnchor identifies one structured table cell.
ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Ta.title: Table Anchor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Te.description: text identifies a rendered-text half-open interval.

endByte.description: end_byte is exclusive within the rendition.

rendition.description: rendition identifies the immutable text rendition.

startByte.description: start_byte is inclusive within the rendition.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Te.title: Text Anchor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Ti.description: TimedAnchor identifies a media time interval and optional anonymous speaker.

speakerEntityId.description: speaker_entity_id is a supported entity reference when available.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Ti.title: Timed Anchor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Vi.description: VideoAnchor identifies a video interval with optional frame and visual bounds.

endFrame.description: end_frame is exclusive when frame addressing is available.

startFrame.description: start_frame is inclusive when frame addressing is available.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Vi.title: Video Anchor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.js.description: EvidenceAnchor locates a modality-native supporting span.
ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.js.title: Evidence Anchor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceRef.jsons.description: EvidenceRef identifies evidence metadata and optionally one precise anchor.

anchorDigest.description: anchor_digest identifies an optional canonical anchor serialization.

evidenceId.description: evidence_id is an opaque evidence identity.

sourceRevisionId.description: source_revision_id identifies the immutable source revision.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceRef.jsons.title: Evidence Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GetMultimodalEvid.description: GetMultimodalEvidenceResponse returns evidence or non-disclosing denial.

error.description: error uses the same static model for absent, denied, and revoked reads.

receipt.description: receipt records the evidence read decision.

success.description: success contains the authorized evidence page.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GetMultimodalEvid.title: Get Multimodal Evidence Response

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GetMultimodalEvid.description: GetMultimodalEvidenceSuccess contains one authorized page of native anchors.

items.description: items lists only anchors owned by the authorized source revision.

nextCursor.description: next_cursor continues within the same bounded listing.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GetMultimodalEvid.title: Get Multimodal Evidence Success

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.MultimodalEvidenc.description: MultimodalEvidenceItem binds one claim-supporting native anchor to its revision.

anchor.description: anchor is the modality-native offset, page, region, or time location.

authorityClass.description: authority_class prevents summaries and model proposals from self-promotion.
authorityClass.title: Authority Class

evidence.description: evidence identifies the immutable evidence and source revision.

supportingTextDigest.description: supporting_text_digest optionally binds exact supporting text bytes.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.MultimodalEvidenc.title: Multimodal Evidence Item

ouroboros.contracts.v1.NormalizedBox.jso.description: NormalizedBox identifies a bounded rectangle using normalized integer coordinates.

bottomPerMille.description: bottom_per_mille is the exclusive bottom coordinate in [0, 1000].

leftPerMille.description: left_per_mille is the inclusive left coordinate in [0, 1000].

rightPerMille.description: right_per_mille is the exclusive right coordinate in [0, 1000].

topPerMille.description: top_per_mille is the inclusive top coordinate in [0, 1000].

ouroboros.contracts.v1.NormalizedBox.jso.title: Normalized Box

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PublicError.jsons.description: PublicError exposes a static public error code with an optional safe render model.

code.description: code is a stable, non-sensitive machine-readable public error code.

render.description: render supplies presentation-safe text for the TUI.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PublicError.jsons.title: Public Error

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Receipt.jsonschem.description: Receipt records the authoritative outcome of an admitted operation.

causal.description: causal binds the outcome to replayable ordering and fencing state.

configurationDigest.description: configuration_digest pins the effective configuration without secret plaintext.

evidence.description: evidence records immutable inputs and outputs supporting this outcome.

operationId.description: operation_id identifies the command, run, or effect being receipted.

reasonCode.description: reason_code is a non-sensitive stable reason, never an upstream error body.

receiptId.description: receipt_id is a globally unique opaque receipt identifier.

recordedAt.description: recorded_at is when the receipt became canonical.

status.description: status is a stable, machine-readable outcome.
status.title: Receipt Status

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Receipt.jsonschem.title: Receipt

ouroboros.contracts.v1.RenderModel.jsons.description: RenderModel is a bounded non-sensitive presentation model for the thin TUI.

actionLabel.description: action_label suggests the next local action without implying authority.

detail.description: detail is bounded static explanatory text and never an upstream error body.

title.description: title is a stable short heading suitable for a terminal status line.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.RenderModel.jsons.title: Render Model

ouroboros.contracts.v1.SourceRange.jsons.description: SourceRange identifies a source-code range using one-based line and column values.

endColumn.description: end_column is a one-based exclusive column number.

endLine.description: end_line is a one-based exclusive line number.

path.description: path is a repository-relative source path.

startColumn.description: start_column is a one-based inclusive column number.

startLine.description: start_line is a one-based inclusive line number.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.SourceRange.jsons.title: Source Range
